verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST API with scoped access tokens, a CLI and an MCP server, but nothing about a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI path returning 404. API tokens, the CLI and the MCP server are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
